desc:
🚨 JOBS & DISASTERS UPDATE! 🚨
Tornadoes, wildfires, tsunamis, meteors and a volcano now hit the islands. Fly emergency jobs, rank up four careers and unlock 40+ emergency aircraft

🎨 NEW PAINT SHOP, LIVERY & DRONE CASES
✨ A BRAND NEW AIRPORT-STYLE LOOK

Build your own airfield from the ground up, grow a fleet from over 150 real aircraft and send them on routes across four islands. Take the controls and fly any plane yourself, restore classics from barn finds, discover hidden locations and earn clearance for military aircraft.

🌍 MULTIPLAYER
Join up to 5 players, each with your own island. Fly to each other's airports and team up on disaster rescues.

🛠️ ROADMAP (in no particular order)
• New build mode with curved taxiways and roads
• New aircraft every week, voted by the community
• Airport reputation
• Aircraft performance upgrades
• Airport visitors
• Flight challenges
• Seasonal events
• More regions
• Moving ships and carriers

Bugs? Go to Settings > Feedback in-game.
